mentions.name: cool.computer
mentions.description: A model-agnostic visual workspace for working with AI artifacts. Users can annotate and draw on artifacts, and so can their AI agents. Artifacts can be shared with colleagues or friends who, with permission, can send comments to the user's agents. When more compute is needed, artifacts automatically turn themselves into microVMs (paid feature) with an 8GB allowance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://cool.computer/

A better, model-agnostic artifact experience to work with AI visually. You can annotate and draw on artifacts, so can your agents. You can share the artifacts with colleagues or friends and with your permission they can send comments to your agents too.

When you need more compute, artifacts turn themselves into microVMs automatically (paid feature) with a 8GB allowance
